en: {player}! You got Olivia's stamp? That's two islands done! We should celebrate. With malasadas.
Congratulations, {player}. I knew you could do it.
Oh, hello again! I've been telling your friends about Aether Paradise. Our ship can take all three of you.
The Aether Foundation would be honoured to have you as our guests. Do think about it!
The sea here is so blue. I could watch it all day.
The resort's malasadas cost twice as much. They're also twice as big!
Aether Paradise is lovely this time of year. Well, it's lovely every time of year.
